notes: Template: ABox contraction on a many-valued relation (located_in: transitive, cardinality:many). Removes "CERN is located in Geneva", the original fact of physics-replace-0013, a stored fact. Yes/no questions are the natural form for the removed fact itself because the relation is many-valued (a wh-question about CERN's city has several answers, Meyrin among them). Cardinality question: another place the model holds (Switzerland); removing one location says nothing about the others, so the answer stays yes. Related near uses the inverse (located_in is tagged inverse:contains). Related far is the revision's binding question through the Large Hadron Collider. Derived: whether CERN is in the city that hosts the WHO headquarters and the one that hosts the ICRC headquarters, both composition on a fact stored about Geneva by name. The revision's country and time-zone questions are not reused: CERN is stored as being in Switzerland on its own, so a model that forgot the city could still answer them. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama). Review fix: the river and language questions were dropped because 'the city where CERN is located' presupposes one city (CERN is based in Meyrin, a suburb) and the Rhone and French apply to the canton and region as well. The new derived questions are yes/no with a bridge only Geneva satisfies (Meyrin hosts neither headquarters), so a model that falls back on Meyrin or the canton still cannot confirm them.
